clues: This beach resort town is in Spain. It sits on Fuerteventura, one of the Canary Islands.
The usual west winds leave this shore sheltered. Its waters stay protected and calm most of the time.
This town was developed for tourists in the 1970s. That late start sets it apart from others.
Sotavento Beach is near this town. It is a site of note where windsurfers race for titles.
Find the start of the Jandia peninsula in the island south. This resort town sits right there by the sea.
